hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at the worst time? We're in Derby and Allestree — emergency callouts within the hour, any day.
services_heading: Complete Heating Services Across Derby & Allestree
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every heating problem with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Boiler won't fire? We diagnose and repair most faults same day. Carry full spare parts and diagnostics equipment on the van.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Safety Checks
services.desc: Annual gas safety certificates and servicing keep your boiler running efficiently and safely. Prevents expensive breakdowns in winter.

services.title: New Boiler Installation
services.desc: Expert fitting of condensing and combi boilers. We handle all paperwork, certification, and disposal of your old unit.

services.title: Central Heating Repairs
services.desc: Radiators not heating, pumps failing, thermostats playing up — we fix the whole system, not just quick patches.

services.title: Landlord Safety Inspections
services.desc: Fully compliant Gas Safe inspections and certificates for rental properties. We'll email reports directly to your tenant.

services.title: Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old inefficient systems with modern, energy-saving boilers and controls. Cut your heating bills by up to 30%.

about_pullquote: We fix heating properly the first time — no shortcuts, no cowboys.
about_para_1: BR Plumbing and Heating has been serving Derby and the surrounding villages for over 15 years. We specialise in gas heating and boiler work, with Gas Safe registration and a reputation built on turning up on time and getting the job done right. Most of our business comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals — which tells you everything you need to know.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're fair and honest. We'll never pressure you into unnecessary work, and we explain what's wrong and why you need it fixed. Whether it's a frozen pipe at 11 p.m. or a planned boiler replacement, we treat your home with the same care we'd show our own.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete nightmare with our boiler — wouldn't start in the middle of winter. Called BR on a Sunday and the engineer was here before lunch. Fixed it within an hour and explained everything as he went. Really professional and fair pricing. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using BR for five years now. They service our boiler every autumn without fail. Always on time, always polite, and they catch little issues before they become expensive problems. Worth every penny for the peace of mind.
reviews.author: Patricia C.

reviews.text: Got quotes from three other engineers for a new boiler. BR was competitive and didn't try to oversell us something we didn't need. Installation was clean, quick, and they made sure we understood how to use all the controls. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: James H.
